# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > An interactive personality assessment tool from Encyclopædia Britannica that explores individual curiosity types through the lens of science, psychology, and notable historical figures.

The Curiosity Compass helps users discover their unique curiosity profile by connecting personality traits with famous scientists, innovators, and thinkers. Built on neuroscience and the science of curiosity, it offers personalized insights for self-discovery and career exploration in STEM and beyond.

- Personality Assessment
- Science of Curiosity

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Interactive Curiosity Compass quiz exploring personality types & curiosity
